content_sections.heading: SKNAU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the SKNAU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download SKNAU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Young Professional II (Plant Breeding): Master's degree in Plant Breeding and Genetics or Genetics and Plant Breeding or Seed Science and Technology with minimum 60% marks or 6.0/10.0 OGPA. Experience in laboratory and filed work, conducting trials, experience in mutation breeding. Young Professional II (Agronomy): Master's degree in Agronomy with minimum 60% marks or 6.0/10.0 OGPA. Experience in weed management in field crops, conducting field trials, herbicide application. Field Assistant: 10+2 in Agriculture subject from recognized education board. Experience in field research and laboratory work.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: All Posts: Minimum age: 21 years, Maximum age: 45 years. Age relaxation: As per ICAR norms and rules of the government.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Screening test may be conducted before interview

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SKNAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Sri Karan Narendra Agriculture University (SKNAU), specifically at SKN College of Agriculture, Jobner, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available under SKNAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts under this recruitment notification are Young Professional-II (YP-II) and Field Assistant on a temporary and contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available across different positions including Young Professional-II and Field Assistant roles.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The mode of application and selection is via a Walk-in interview process. Candidates need to report directly to the designated venue with all required documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 05 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they attend on the specified date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for Young Professional-II?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in relevant agricultural science, Plant Breeding and Genetics, Seed Science and Technology, or Agronomy with minimum 60% marks or 6.0/10.0 OGPA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Field Assistant position must have passed 10+2 in Agriculture subject from a recognized education board.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for SKNAU positions?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per ICAR and government norms.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary structure for these posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Young Professional-II will receive a fixed salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month, and Field Assistants will receive Rs. 22,000/- per month without HRA.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can check the official website at https://skncoa.sknau.ac.in for detailed notification guidelines, application requirements, and venue instructions.
